name: section-marker-rev
description: See a song's highlighted sections straight from your playbar.

exceptions.reason: Injects the marker containers into the client's playback progress bar via its x-progressBar-* classes; there is no classmap path for the playbar slider area.
Fetches analysis through Spicetify.getAudioData, the client's audio-analysis entry point; stdlib does not surface it, and it does not cache, so the module keeps its own.
Peeks at the upcoming track through Spicetify.Queue to preload its analysis; stdlib does not surface the queue.
The test harness installs a fake Spicetify global so analysis-loader.ts can be driven in Node; standing that global up is the whole point of the file.
